definition.expected: Uniform reachable enemy node; uniform8 headings; half human/squid on potentially swimmable nodes, human only otherwise; equal3 finite behaviors; R uniform12..25f; omega uniform0.8..1.2 times measured220.785deg/s; declared aiming priors.
definition.maxmin: max over evaluated tactics of min over3 fixed behavior rules of expected KO. Also retain the stricter E_initial_state[min_behavior P(KO|state,behavior)].
definition.success: Target KO, including trades; no native kill guarantee.
definition.mc_interval: Weighted stratified Hoeffding, union bound across all evaluated tactic-behavior means, total delta0.05. Only MC error inside this fixed model, not model/native uncertainty. Statewise-min field has no claimed simultaneous interval.

fine_stage_timing_scope: Completed pre-pause point wall sums plus resumed job wall; aborted in-progress work and old inter-point overhead unknown. Not uninterrupted job wall.

limits: Normalized resource budget is checked on each sequence; 146f rehook preaim and B trajectory are included.
Multi-target DP primitive is not populated by native conditional kernels; these are single-target kill probabilities, not maximum multi-kill scores.
Return damage remains unknown, no invulnerability assumed.
No native .52 ranking cohort: Spearman/Kendall/calibration error are undefined, not zero.
Only six single-hook quantile candidates plus three beam sequences per map finely evaluated; coarse screening does not certify excluded hooks.
Beam nodes capped48/map, width12, maximum3 hooks; not an exhaustive continuous-surface optimum.
Candidate binding assumes static material geometry; native feasibility remains unverified for most points.
117f B6/aim/face template matches one pilot only; cross-point control time and jump-to-floor remain uncalibrated.
Initial squid is currently a low-eye approximation throughout the duel; emergence/ink and eye-height transition on shooting are incomplete.
Attacker linear lead uses target state supplied by finite scenario; target acquisition is idealized and is not a policy implementation.
Gun flight and distance falloff are phenomenological fits; sparse native evidence does not identify all ballistic defaults/PDF.
No armor benefit assumed; native armor/contact/phase timing remain uncertain.
Flight contact blast is not included; scores concern the final target two-sword tactic within30u with <=6u opponent movement.
Ray geometry matches CollisionMesh, but that alone does not validate weapons, callbacks or native timing.
